observations.statement: All 69 authorized receipts were individually resolved: 65 successes and four execution failures. All successful validations use 3,234,051 impressions. The 16 runtime-history records match their full receipts and the entire trajectory index matches status/AUC/wall values.

All four round22 variants succeed. Both typed traces report schema2, compatibility_selftest_pass=1, initial_gate_pass=1, exact initial input/logit/loss and parameter bits flags, and zero gate-after/repeat gradient relative error. This establishes candidate-reported local gate success and execution compatibility; it is not an independent whole-run nonperturbation certificate.

Round22 magnitude minus none AUC is -0.000030525094314337586 with tracing off and -0.00017054648215741874 with tracing v2. Corresponding Logloss differences are +0.000011692370851718037 and +0.00006511215071500209. Both specified magnitude implementations lose on both population metrics.

Tracing-v2 minus tracing-off magnitude is -0.00014002138784308116 AUC and +0.000053419779863284056 Logloss. For none the corresponding metric differences are exactly zero, and all 23 slice dictionaries replay. These are one-run cell comparisons, not proof of a tracer causal effect.

The original magnitude source hash 6e9e41cc4cf0e92b1036f82de88e6c214343288d1fa7de2865237d3d580106d2 and config appear in round17, round19 exact17 replay and round22 trace-off magnitude. Their AUCs are 0.6152795936767026, 0.6149279138846995 and 0.6150716634131729. Source edits therefore cannot be the sole necessary explanation of all score drift; unobserved execution state and numerical causes remain possible.

Typed M and N input sketches agree at all five captured calls 0,1,512,8192,14660. Initial parameter and logit sketches agree. Their gradient sketches differ at call0, parameter sketches at call1, and logit sketches first differ among sampled points at call512. These are different interventions, so this is expected treatment divergence, not same-source reproducibility failure. No duplicate run of either schema2 source exists in this round.

Both typed traces report zero repeated-gradient relative discrepancy at each of five captured states, 14,661 training calls and 60,045,735 examples through the selected checkpoint. Their inherited two-probe surrogate relative error maxima are 1.5897416677926817e-08 for magnitude and zero for none. Candidate-owned sketches omit optimizer/RNG state and cannot certify a complete path.

Round21's four failed attempts retain null validation/diagnostics/train-time/parameter/memory fields and the explicit float32/64-only tracing RuntimeError. Their summed wall time is 21.4754219353199 seconds. Round22 successful typed tracing supersedes a continuing compatibility-block interpretation but does not erase those failures or identify their exact offending tensor.

The latest knowledge-usage record says prior admitted source inspection found v1 already supported integer/bool tensors and restricted unsupported floating types. This narrows the earlier integer/bool conjecture at the level of declared source inspection. This phase exposes no candidate source or v1 failing tensor, so the exact cause and dtype mapping are not independently verified; raw dtype codes are retained without inventing names.

Baseline static, simple pooled history and local target-aware history AUCs are 0.6050036144838207, 0.6102261137080656 and 0.6133619861190683. Full count correction harms both history references; half correction helps pooled history but harms the target-aware reference. These are measured scientific negatives and mixed results from successful execution.

Same-field products and aligned unit normalization improve local matched references at seed42. Constant tangent and history-mean replacements nearly match full normalization, while several crossed, identity, action-grouped and reassigned variants lose. Event-specific inverse norms, temporal ownership and action semantics are not established as necessary causes.

Original complete-row magnitude beats none on AUC by 0.0001774051692153833 but worsens Logloss by 0.000006378891288821853; direction-only loses AUC, while the projection bridge has the lowest observed Logloss, 0.19649601237450445. Product-role-sum controls in round16 and complete-row controls in round17 target different quantities; their outcomes must not be conflated.

Round18 rotated allocation and uniform-energy controls both lose population AUC and Logloss to none, and its magnitude bridge also loses. Round19 cross-source common-state probes report near-repeat-floor gradient discrepancies and zero sampled cross-source Adam update discrepancies, yet end-to-end magnitude performance still drifts.

Latest declared knowledge use maps scoped memory and inherited DIN to all four executed IDs/hashes/success statuses. CRAFT and UniDot were considered with no variants implementing their mechanisms. Usage documentation agrees with execution provenance; it measures neither scientific transfer nor causal knowledge value.
